say:5:1510211003:1.text: Hold your tongue! You're speaking to the Hunting God!
say:5:1510211003:1.source_cn: 索，砍断你自己的手指！竟敢对狩猎神出言不逊！
say:5:1510211003:1.male: Hold your tongue! You're speaking to the Hunting God!
say:5:1510211003:1.female: Hold your tongue! You're speaking to the Hunting Goddess!

say:6:1510211004:1.text: Ignorant youngling, the ritual was successful. The Hunting God himself has come to aid the Wildborn.
say:6:1510211004:1.source_cn: 无知的年轻人啊，祭祀仪式成功，狩猎神本尊亲自降临，来协...
say:6:1510211004:1.male: Ignorant youngling, the ritual was successful. The Hunting God himself has come to aid the Wildborn.
say:6:1510211004:1.female: Ignorant youngling, the ritual was successful. The Hunting Goddess herself has come to aid the Wildborn.

say:9:1510211007:0.text: Tangle, just tell us what happened.

say:11:1510211008:0.text: By fang and claw, your wounds... Don't tell me <style="highlight">Perseus</style> came himself?

say:12:1510211009:0.text: No, he didn't come! There was only one warband... but they were as cunning as him and set traps in advance.
say:12:1510211009:0.source_cn: 不，他没来！只有一支小队……但是其他人像他一样狡猾，提...

choice_prompt:13:1510211009.text: No, he didn't come! There was only one warband... but they were as cunning as him and set traps in advance.
choice_prompt:13:1510211009.source_cn: 不，他没来！只有一支小队……但是其他人像他一样狡猾，提前设下了陷阱！

say:14:1510211010:1.text: He's the leader of the Halian soldiers and a slippery eel in battle!
say:14:1510211010:1.source_cn: 呼临人的战士头领，奸猾的泥鳅！

say:15:1510211011:1.text: <style="highlight">Two seasons ago, that scaleless snake took Mirehold!</style> Rightful land of the Wildborn! Now, we will take it back!

choice_prompt:16:1510211011.text: <style="highlight">Two seasons ago, that scaleless snake took Mirehold!</style> Rightful land of the Wildborn! Now, we will take it back!
choice_prompt:16:1510211011.source_cn: <style=highlight>半年前，他带人占领了肥沃的水泽营地</style>，那本来是我们雅库伯尔的领地！

say:17:1510211012:0.text: Because of human greed! The Wildborn and the Halians had long respected the ravine as our border. Skirmishes have happened, yes, but never like this. Without warning, they've launched a full-scale invasion.
say:17:1510211012:0.source_cn: 因为人类贪婪！狩猎神大人，雅库伯尔和呼临早就以深壑为界...
say:17:1510211012:0.male: Because of human greed! The Wildborn and the Halians had long respected the ravine as our border. Skirmishes have happened, yes, but never like this. Without warning, they've launched a full-scale invasion.
say:17:1510211012:0.female: Because of human greed! The Wildborn and the Halians had long respected the ravine as our border. Skirmishes have happened, yes, but never like this. Without warning, they've launched a full-scale invasion.

say:18:1510211013:1.text: Only after losing Mirehold did we realize with Perseus' cruel and cunning tactics, the human assault won't stop. They wish to swallow up everything.
say:18:1510211013:1.source_cn: 请原谅我们，失去了交界地后，我们才意识到在珀尔修斯的残...
say:18:1510211013:1.male: Only after losing Mirehold did we realize with Perseus' cruel and cunning tactics, the human assault won't stop. They wish to swallow up everything.
say:18:1510211013:1.female: Only after losing Mirehold did we realize with Perseus' cruel and cunning tactics, the human assault won't stop. They wish to swallow up everything.

say:19:1510211014:1.text: Humans. Savage beasts in fine clothes, nothing more. They take what they please and call it theirs.
say:19:1510211014:1.source_cn: 呸，人类，他们才是真正的野兽，想要什么就直接动手！

say:20:1510211015:1.text: Strength is our answer. With it, we'll reclaim what was stolen.
say:20:1510211015:1.source_cn: 但是只要我们足够强大，就足以夺回失去的一切。

say:21:1510211016:1.text: Show us the way, Tangle. Where are the other warriors? With the blessing of the Wild Moon, it's time to strike back!
say:21:1510211016:1.source_cn: 索，指路，其他战士在哪里？有狩猎神庇佑，反击的时刻到了！
say:21:1510211016:1.male: Show us the way, Tangle. Where are the other warriors? With the blessing of the Wild Moon, it's time to strike back!
say:21:1510211016:1.female: Show us the way, Tangle. Where are the other warriors? With the blessing of the Wild Moon, it's time to strike back!

say:22:1510211017:1.text: They went in the direction of the setting sun! May your spear taste blood, my brethren!
say:22:1510211017:1.source_cn: 他们在太阳下落的方向！祝、祝雅库伯尔猎杀成功！

choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 人类为何占领你们的土地？

choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 别废话，现在是什么情况？

say:25:1510211006:1.text: Herdmaster, please spare her life! For now at least!
say:25:1510211006:1.male: Herdmaster, please spare her life! For now at least!
say:25:1510211006:1.female: Herdmaster, please spare her life! For now at least!
